resolved_by: Sentencing Commission Amendment 775 (2013), which the opinion says was intended to resolve the split over withholding a § 3E1.1(b) motion for interests outside § 3E1.1; Amendment 820 (2023) later deleted that application note and defined 'preparing for trial.'
issue: Can the government withhold a third-level acceptance-of-responsibility motion under U.S.S.G. § 3E1.1(b) because the defendant refuses to waive appeal rights?
quote: The Commission intended the amendment to resolve a circuit split over whether the government may withhold a motion based on interests not identified in § 3E1.1.
cite: United States v. Yates, No. 25-2987 (9th Cir. 2026)
